mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.5% in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in real GDP (more than 1% quarter-over-quarter) indicates a weakening economy, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where GDPC1 dropped by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in unemployment rate (more than 0.5% in a month) signals labor market weakness, which leads to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE increased by more than 0.5% in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (more than 1% month-over-month) indicates a strong supply side, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO increased by more than 1% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in retail sales (more than 2% month-over-month) signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where RSAFS increased by more than 2% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (more than 0.3% in a month) combined with an increase in nonfarm payrolls (more than 100,000) signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decreases > 0.3% and PAYEMS increases > 100,000 in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where UNRATE decreased by more than 0.3% and PAYEMS increased by more than 100,000 in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate combined with a decrease in the consumer price index signals a disinflationary environment, which reduces real interest rates and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS decreases and CPIAUCSL decreases in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL decreased in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (more than 5% month-over-month) signals a strengthening housing market, which boosts related industries and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where HOUST increased by more than 5% month-over-month.
